documents.title: Listing of Equity Shares of Baheti Recycling Industries Ltd

analysis.summary: Baheti Recycling reported strong H1 FY27 performance with a 67.69% YoY revenue growth and a 105.83% increase in PAT. Management has revised its FY28 revenue guidance upward to ₹1,300+ crores, citing improved business visibility and expansion opportunities. The company is actively expanding its Aluminium Wire Rod division capacity and has received in-principle approval for migration to the Main Boards of NSE and BSE. Strategic focus remains on increasing high-margin specialty products and optimizing operational efficiency. Management reported a strong operational performance for FY26 with revenue rising to 725 crores and profit reaching 27 crores, driven by higher operational efficiency and margin expansion.

guidance.claim: The company revised its FY28 revenue guidance upward from ₹1,100 crores to ₹1,300+ crores.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we have revised our FY28 revenue guidance upwards from ₹1,100 crores to ₹1,300+ crores, while maintaining our existing margin trajectory.

guidance.claim: The company targets to reach full capacity utilization by FY28.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to ramp up utilization, full capacity utilization by FY28.

guidance.claim: Phase 1 of the aluminum wire rod project has an annual revenue potential of 250 crores.
guidance.quote: We are targeting in Phase 1 around 12,500 metric ton per annum, with an annual revenue potential of 250-odd crores

guidance.claim: In Phase 2 of the aluminum wire rod project, revenue will increase by another 250 crores, bringing the total plant revenue to around 500 crores.
guidance.quote: In phase 2, it will increase to 25,000 tons. That, that means the revenue will also increase by another 250 odd crores. So, total revenue from this plant will be somewhere around 500 odd crores.

guidance.claim: Management is heading into FY27 with a minimum order book of 200 crores, excluding the aluminum wire rod plant.
guidance.quote: We are heading into FY27 with an order of Minimum 200 crores with us. And there are a lot of excitement development. This is excluding order book or the plant of aluminum wire rod.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margins in the recycling industry are sustainable between 7% to 10%.
guidance.quote: See, the EBITDA margin in our industry is a sustainable EBITDA margin which we are working on. So anywhere between 7 to 10% is very it's quite sustainable EBITDA margin in our kind of industry

guidance.claim: The company aims to exceed a revenue milestone of ₹1,200 Crores by FY28.
guidance.quote: We are confidently positioned to exceed a Revenue milestone of ₹1,200Cr by FY28

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that confidence in growth prospects is supported by increasing demand and a growing presence across key industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Over the past few quarters, our confidence in the Company's growth prospects has strengthened, supported by increasing demand, capacity enhancements and a growing presence across key industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted due to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, pushing customers towards reliable secondary sources.
demand_outlook.quote: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted, particularly from the geopolitical tension going on in the Middle East, and that is pushing customer everywhere towards reliable secondary sources.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand and government policy tailwinds exist alongside favorable global industry dynamics for secondary recycled aluminum.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand is that the government policy tailwinds are there, the global industry dynamics are in favor of secondary recycling aluminium.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for aluminum wire rod is huge as it is an upbringing industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Aluminum wire rod, if I talk about aluminum wire rod, aluminum wire rod is a good industry. It is an upbringing industry and the demand is huge in aluminum wire.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is experiencing steady domestic demand for secondary aluminium.
demand_outlook.quote: As we step into Q1 FY27, our confirmed order book already stands at over ₹175 Crores, a reflection of the steady demand for secondary aluminium domestically and the trust our clients continue to place in us.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its Aluminium Wire Rod division capacity in two phases to reach a total of 25,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: A key priority for us is the expansion of our Aluminium Wire Rod division, where we are expanding our capacity on our existing owned land in two phases. Over time, we intend to have a total wire-rod capacity of 25,000 MT, representing a revenue opportunity of approximately ₹500 crores annually.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this, we are now ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing around 25 crores to build out the aluminum wire rod product in two phases on existing freehold land in Dahegam.
capex_expansion.quote: We are investing somewhere around 25-odd crores to build this out in two phases on our existing freehold land in Dahegam

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the aluminum wire rod project will require a maximum of 5 crores for putting up the furnace and related items.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2 would be 5 crores maximum in putting up the furnace and all.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing ₹20–25 Crores in FY27 to build an Aluminium Wire Rod division.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity side, we are putting ₹20–25 Crores to work in FY27 to build out our Aluminium Wire Rod division on our existing freehold land.

capex_expansion.claim: Five additional electric furnaces are scheduled for commissioning in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, we have been replacing our older pit furnaces with more Electric Furnaces, taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

margins_costs.claim: The company is increasing the production of high-margin specialty products to improve EBITDA per tonne.
margins_costs.quote: We are increasing production of high-margin specialty products that deliver stronger value to customers and meaningfully improve our utilisation and EBITDA/tonne.

margins_costs.claim: The cost of production increased by 15% because of fuel prices.
margins_costs.quote: See, the cost of production has increased, no doubt about it, because of the fuel prices, the cost of production has increased by 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The captive solar plant is expected to reduce power costs for electric furnaces starting from Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

orders_capacity.claim: The company aims to have 5 new electric furnaces under complete utilization by the end of FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: 5 NEW Electric Furnaces To be under complete utilisation by end of FY27

orders_capacity.claim: With the addition of 5 new electrical furnaces, total installed capacity will stand at 38,000 tons annually.
orders_capacity.quote: With this addition, our total installed capacity will stand to 38,000 tons annually.

orders_capacity.claim: Phase 1 of the wire rod division targets 12,500 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: We are targeting in Phase 1 around 12,500 metric ton per annum, with an annual revenue potential of 250-odd crores

orders_capacity.claim: Phase 2 of the wire rod division will increase capacity to 25,000 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: In phase 2, it will increase to 25,000 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The confirmed order book for Q1 FY27 exceeds ₹175 Crores.
orders_capacity.quote: As we step into Q1 FY27, our confirmed order book already stands at over ₹175 Crores, a reflection of the steady demand for secondary aluminium domestically and the trust our clients continue to place in us.

capital_allocation.claim: The company seeks to maximize surplus funds from operations and asset monetization.
capital_allocation.quote: At Baheti (BRIL), We seek to maximize surplus funds from business operations as well as relevant monetization of assets and investments.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is actively focused on reducing debt and improving key financial ratios.
capital_allocation.quote: Furthermore, company’s actively focused on Reducing the debt and improving the key financial ratio.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital efficiency is being improved through direct connections with OEMs resulting in better payment terms.
capital_allocation.quote: Lastly, we are also working actively on avenues to make our working capital more efficient, which will be happen as we are now directly connected with the OEMs with better margins and better payment terms

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised ₹7.48 Crores through a Preferential Allotment to support working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: We also raised ₹7.48 Crores through a Preferential Allotment to keep working capital healthy as volumes grow.

risks_headwinds.claim: Imported raw material accounts for around 80% of total raw material.
Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened global primary aluminium supply.
risks_headwinds.quote: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and the pressure on availability is real.
